declared difference (truth fix T5, equal-value skip): Baja's ComplexSlotMap skips a write whose new value equals the
current one for a simple value (setDouble's BDouble.equals test, setBoolean's oldValue != newValue test,
set(Property, BValue)'s oldValue.isSimple() && equals test; organized/baja/baja/vineflower/com/tridium/sys/schema/
ComplexSlotMap.java:1239, :860, :637), so a simple-typed slot only dirties the station when its value changes. The
seven writes modelled on the live CompPan false positives no longer report: condenser1-3AutoLocked (flipped on
edges by the model), faultReset (written under a test of its own getter), rotationLeadIndex /
rotationLastChangeMs / stagingConfigRevision (event counters and an event timestamp in the model), and a
non-simple stagingBackup written under a change flag. The three hours accumulators (the model adds a time delta
every cycle: hours[k] += dtH) still report, as do a write of the slot's own value plus a delta, a clock read and
a non-simple value written every cycle (no framework skip).

-- BCC.java --
package com.x;
public class BCC extends BComponent {
  public static final Property condenser1Hours = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property condenser2Hours = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property condenser3Hours = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property condenser1AutoLocked = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, false, null);
  public static final Property condenser2AutoLocked = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, false, null);
  public static final Property condenser3AutoLocked = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, false, null);
  public static final Property faultReset = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.OPERATOR, new BStatusBoolean(false), null);
  public static final Property rotationLeadIndex = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 1d, null);
  public static final Property rotationLastChangeMs = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property stagingConfigRevision = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property runHours = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property lastRunMs = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY, 0d, null);
  public static final Property statusOut = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY, new BStatusNumeric(), null);
  public static final Property stagingBackup = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY, new BStatusString(""), null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { execute(); }
  void execute() {
    ctl.step(now, dtH);
    setCondenser1Hours(ctl.hours[0]);
    setCondenser2Hours(ctl.hours[1]);
    setCondenser3Hours(ctl.hours[2]);
    setCondenser1AutoLocked(ctl.autoLocked[0]);
    setCondenser2AutoLocked(ctl.autoLocked[1]);
    setCondenser3AutoLocked(ctl.autoLocked[2]);
    if (getFaultReset().getValue()) { ctl.resetFaults(); setFaultReset(new BStatusBoolean(false)); }
    setRotationLeadIndex(CompressorControl.modelLeadIndexToSlot(ctl.rotationLeadIndex));
    setRotationLastChangeMs(CompressorControl.modelLastChangeToSlot(ctl.lastRotationMs));
    setStagingConfigRevision((double) ctl.configRevision);
    setRunHours(getRunHours() + dtH);
    setLastRunMs((double) BAbsTime.now().getMillis());
    setStatusOut(new BStatusNumeric(ctl.demand));
    if (stagingConfigChanged) setStagingBackup(new BStatusString(ctl.snapshot()));
  }
}

-- CompressorControl.java --
package com.x;
class CompressorControl {
  double[] hours = new double[3];
  boolean[] autoLocked = new boolean[3];
  int rotationLeadIndex = 0;
  long lastRotationMs = 0L;
  long configRevision = 0L;
  void step(long now, double dtH) {
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      if (running[k]) hours[k] += dtH;
      if (lockoutRequested[k]) autoLocked[k] = true;
      else if (modes[k] != 0) autoLocked[k] = false;
    }
    if (configChangedThisStep) configRevision++;
    if (rotate) {
      rotationLeadIndex = (rotationLeadIndex + 1) % N;
      lastRotationMs = now;
    }
  }
}
